mentions.name: MyJackfruit
mentions.description: AI-powered app-building platform (positioned as a competitor to Lovable and base44) that produces production-level apps in weeks and simple apps in a couple of hours, rather than 7-minute prototypes. Each app is developed with Systems Engineering: stakeholders and product values are mapped out quantitatively, and the AI codes against those quantified stakeholder and product values instead of a prompt. Apps are built on a scalable, secure, fast, access-controlled, ontology-based foundation with a focus on data ownership, and developers can use GitHub and all their usual tools.
mentions.problem: Existing AI app builders deliver quick prototypes (built in minutes from a prompt) rather than production-level apps; MyJackfruit addresses the gap of getting to production quality quickly by coding against quantified stakeholder and product values.
mentions.audience: Developers, who can use GitHub and all their tools with the platform.
